stem.text: The diagram shows an enzyme, its substrate and an enzyme–substrate complex.

stem.alt: Diagram of an enzyme, a substrate and an enzyme–substrate complex, with an arrow between the enzyme and substrate and the complex.

stem.text: Which statement explains how this substrate is able to enter the active site of this enzyme?

A.text: Contact between the substrate and the enzyme causes a change in the enzyme shape.

B.text: The shape of the active site and the shape of the substrate are complementary.

C.text: The substrate within the active site forms hydrogen bonds with amino acids.

D.text: When the enzyme–substrate complex forms, the tertiary structure of the enzyme changes.
